name: Badge Install (HEMI badge, Trim 2 station 1940L)
source: Client golden set, 2026-10-31. V1.1 = before, V2.0 = after; V2.0's revision history lists the client's own changes.

sop-0002-v3.pdf.label: SOP-0002 v3
sop-0002-v3.pdf.notes: 6 one-line steps, revision + date, no line/station, no limits, no reaction plan.

sw-0002-v1.1-before.pdf.label: SW-0002 V1.1
sw-0002-v1.1-before.pdf.notes: Approved header with line/station, green button, 'STOP and notify the team leader'. No limits, no PPE, no reasons.
